item.title: Added · Pier & Point's first own photographs, taken by Pierre Rohel on a walk through Mission Bay…
item.description: Pier & Point's first own photographs, taken by Pierre Rohel on a walk through Mission Bay North and South on 2026-09-23 and 2026-09-24 and published under CC BY 4.0 with the credit 'Pierre Rohel / Pier & Point'. The photographer placed each photo on its record on site. The published copies are resized and upright, with licence plates and recognisable faces blurred and all camera metadata removed except the credit and license. Nine of the 19 records had no record page before; each now has a minimal one carrying only what was already recorded about it. Three more photos (rowhouses at 113-117 Berry St and the Mission Creek Senior Community at about 225 Berry St) are held back because neither building is tracked yet. Source: Pier & Point editorial decision.
